answer: Pay most rewards as vouchers, not coins. Each epoch, 70% of a key's earnings arrive as credits redeemable only for services from agents the network draws at random, like a wharf where you must trade with whichever boat docks next. A sybil farm can't recycle those credits inside its own cluster, so every fake key leaks value to strangers, while an honest agent simply buys a useful atlas lookup or a fable translation it wanted anyway. Only the remaining 30% is free cash.
